actions.name: hold breath
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can hold its breath for 1 hour.

actions.name: multiple heads
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has five heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being &reference[blinded apply=false], &reference[charmed apply=false], &reference[deafened apply=false], &reference[frightened apply=false], &reference[stunned apply=false], and knocked &reference[unconscious apply=false]. Whenever the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies. At the end of its turn, it grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire damage since its last turn. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} regains [[/healing]] for each head regrown in this way. Foundry Note The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s heads can be kept track of via the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.K4vsSlHqbBAHUDHY.Item.fsAeJDaI0a6sBeFk.ActiveEffect.jALTzc0GXXaDjFNQ]{Hydra Head} active effects on it. Apply or remove this effect each time the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} regrows or loses heads.

actions.name: reactive heads
actions.desc: For each head the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for &reference[opportunity attacks].

actions.name: wakeful
actions.desc: While the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The hydra makes as many [[/item .fYE4f0Oa2I0MetId]]{bite} attacks as it has heads ([[lookup @flags.world.hydra-head-count]]{1}).
